title.zh: THORChain 拒绝 Bitget 封锁黑客地址的要求
title.en: THORChain Pushes Back on Bitget’s Demand to Block Hacker Addresses

current_state.zh:
THORChain 拒绝了 Bitget 要求其封锁与该交易所被盗资金相关地址的要求，随后一个被 Bitget 标记的地址通过该协议完成了 XRP 兑换比特币的交易。OKX 的 Star Xu（徐明星）也对 THORChain 将自身与比特币相提并论的说法提出质疑。

交易所的请求与协议的拒绝，使“去中心化跨链基础设施是否会配合冻结被盗资金相关地址”这一问题进入公众视野。Star Xu 的质疑也直接挑战了该协议自比比特币的说法。

在 Bitget 提出请求之后，该被标记地址通过 THORChain 将 XRP 换成 BTC。Star Xu 的反对意见集中在 THORChain 与比特币的类比上。
current_state.en: THORChain rejected Bitget's demand to block hacker-linked addresses, after which a flagged address completed an XRP-to-bitcoin swap, drawing pushback from OKX's Star Xu over the protocol's Bitcoin comparisons.

updates.detailed_summary_en: THORChain rejected Bitget's demand to block hacker-linked addresses, after which a flagged address completed an XRP-to-bitcoin swap, drawing pushback from OKX's Star Xu over the protocol's Bitcoin comparisons.
updates.background_zh: THORChain 是一个去中心化跨链流动性协议，允许在不同区块链之间直接兑换数字资产，无需依赖中心化交易所。其官方 FAQ 称，该协议没有中心化治理机构或 DAO，协议升级由开发者社区提出并协调，节点参与其中。Bitget 成立于 2018 年，是一家中心化加密货币交易所。
updates.background_en: THORChain is a decentralized cross-chain liquidity protocol that enables swaps of digital assets across different blockchains without relying on centralized exchanges. According to its FAQ, it has no central governance body or DAO, with protocol upgrades proposed and coordinated by the developer community and node operators. Bitget, founded in 2018, is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange.
updates.market_impact_zh: 最直接的敞口是 THORChain 的原生代币 RUNE 及其跨链兑换活动，因为拒绝配合交易所的冻结请求可能影响中心化交易所及其用户通过此类渠道转移资金的方式。该争议也会使 THORChain 上的 XRP 与 BTC 交易对受到更多关注，但这属于治理与合规层面的问题，而非全市场性事件。
updates.market_impact_en: The most direct exposure is THORChain’s RUNE token and its cross-chain swap activity, since a refusal to honor exchange freeze requests can affect how centralized exchanges and their users route funds through such venues. The dispute also draws scrutiny to XRP and BTC pairs on THORChain, though it is a governance and compliance question rather than a market-wide event.
